description: Find human-reviewed research notes about new products, replacement workflows, changed flows and build-versus-buy lessons. Returns original posts and primary sources with explicit author-reported versus documented claims and unknown costs. These are research notes, not tested recipes or verified savings. Private queue drafts are never returned. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses). Tool results are summarized; exit tools log only result counts, qualification flags and public evidence statuses, not answer contents. Don't send personal data or secrets.
name: search_discoveries
title: Search reviewed software discoveries
